ru.proposal: {P1}, предложи игроку {P2} в вашем личном разговоре только между вами каждому предложить спокойный пейзаж для рисунка и найти одну деталь, которая подходит обоим; пропуск разрешён.
ru.responder: Игрок {P2} может согласиться, предложить своё условие или отказаться без объяснений.

en.proposal: {P1}, invite {P2} in your private conversation between yourselves to each suggest a calm landscape for a drawing and find one detail both like; skipping is allowed.
en.responder: {P2} may agree, set their own condition, or decline without giving a reason.

tr.proposal: {P1}, {P2} adlı oyuncuya yalnızca ikinizin özel konuşmasında sakin resim manzarası için birer öneri sunup ikinizin de sevdiği bir ayrıntıyı bulmayı öner. Geçmek serbest.
tr.responder: {P2} kabul edebilir, kendi koşulunu belirtebilir veya açıklama yapmadan reddedebilir.

authoring.source_notes: Agent-authored in-person private-pair draft concepts and RU/EN/TR draft localizations. Assumes an already available mutually chosen private moment; does not instruct leaving, isolation, contact or disclosure. No external card collection used. Human originality, rights, safety, cultural suitability, similarity, diversity and tri-locale review NOT performed; not approved or publishable.
